screen.subtitle: Keep Meeting Guard in step with your connected calendars and the calendars on this phone.

google.title: Google Calendar
google.description: Two-way sync with your primary Google Calendar. Meetings you create here appear in Google Calendar (with invitations for participants), and your Google events get Meeting Guard alerts.
google.permissionNeededHint: Meeting Guard no longer has access to your Google Calendar. Grant access again to keep syncing.
google.firstSyncSummary: Imported {{created}} events and sent {{pushed}} meetings to Google Calendar.
google.firstSyncFailed: Connected, but the first sync did not finish: {{error}} Meeting Guard will try again automatically.
google.scopeDenied: Calendar access was not granted. You can connect again at any time.
google.disconnectMessage: Events imported from Google Calendar will be removed from Meeting Guard. Nothing is deleted from your Google Calendar.

outlook.title: Outlook Calendar
outlook.description: Two-way sync with the calendar of your Microsoft account (Outlook, Microsoft 365). Meetings you create here appear in Outlook, repeating ones included, and your Outlook events get Meeting Guard alerts.
outlook.firstSyncSummary: Imported {{created}} events and sent {{pushed}} meetings to Outlook.
outlook.firstSyncFailed: Connected, but the first sync did not finish: {{error}} Meeting Guard will try again automatically.
outlook.connectFailed: The Microsoft sign-in did not finish. Please try again.
outlook.disconnectMessage: Events imported from Outlook will be removed from Meeting Guard. Nothing is deleted from your Outlook calendar.

todo.title: Microsoft To Do
todo.description: Two-way sync of your tasks with Microsoft To Do on the same Microsoft account as Outlook. Title, notes, due date, reminder and done state go both ways.
todo.connectFirst: Connect Outlook above first. Tasks sync through the same Microsoft account.
todo.chooseList: Which list should your tasks go to?
todo.listsFailed: Your To Do lists could not be loaded: {{error}}
todo.needsListHint: Choose a list so new tasks reach Microsoft To Do.
todo.firstSyncSummary: Imported {{created}} tasks and sent {{pushed}} tasks to To Do.
todo.firstSyncFailed: Turned on, but the first sync did not finish: {{error}} Meeting Guard will try again automatically.
todo.disableMessage: Tasks imported from To Do will be removed from Meeting Guard. Nothing is deleted in Microsoft To Do.
todo.permissionHint: Microsoft has not allowed task access for this connection yet. Stop the Outlook sync above and connect it again to grant it.

gtasks.title: Google Tasks
gtasks.description: Two-way sync of your tasks with Google Tasks on the Google account signed in on this phone. Title, notes, due date and done state go both ways.
gtasks.connectFirst: Sign in with Google on this device first. Tasks sync through that Google account.
gtasks.chooseList: Which list should your tasks go to?
gtasks.listsFailed: Your Google Tasks lists could not be loaded: {{error}}
gtasks.needsListHint: Choose a list so new tasks reach Google Tasks.
gtasks.firstSyncSummary: Imported {{created}} tasks and sent {{pushed}} tasks to Google Tasks.
gtasks.firstSyncFailed: Turned on, but the first sync did not finish: {{error}} Meeting Guard will try again automatically.
gtasks.scopeDenied: Google Tasks access was not granted. The sync stays off until you allow it.
gtasks.disableMessage: Tasks imported from Google Tasks will be removed from Meeting Guard. Nothing is deleted in Google Tasks.
gtasks.permissionHint: Google has not allowed task access for this account yet. Stop the sync and start it again to grant it.

device.title: Calendars on this phone
device.description: Import events from the calendars on this phone and, if you like, add your Meeting Guard meetings to one of them.

permission.denied: Calendar access is turned off for Meeting Guard.

device.empty: There are no calendars on this phone.

export.title: Add Meeting Guard meetings to
export.none: Don't add them to a phone calendar
export.hint: Only Meeting Guard meetings are added, without calendar reminders (Meeting Guard alerts you). Repeating meetings are not added in this version.
